entities.name: Ioana Pârvulescu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ioana Pârvulescu is a Romanian writer. She was born in Brașov and studied at the University of Bucharest. She graduated in 1983, and went on to complete a PhD in literature in 1999. She teaches modern literature at the same university.
